board: GSL Vacancy 2026 - 91 Technical Assistant, EOT Crane Operator and More PostsGSL Vacancy 2026
title: Technical Assistant, Junior Supervisor, Welder, Nurse, Shipwright Fitter and Other Posts
qualification: For Technical Assistant positions, a Diploma in the relevant engineering discipline is compulsory. Candidates possessing only B.E. or B.Tech qualifications without the required Diploma will not be considered eligible. The notification also specifies acceptable grouped engineering disciplines for certain posts.
salary: Selected candidates will receive consolidated monthly remuneration according to the post and year of service. The first-year salary ranges from Rs. 27,200 to Rs. 41,400 per month. Different consolidated pay amounts are prescribed for the second and third years. || Applicable statutory deductions such as Provident Fund, ESI and Income Tax will be made from consolidated pay. Medical benefits, canteen facilities, welfare facilities and Group Personal Accident Insurance may be provided as per GSL rules.
age_limit: The upper age limit for most Goa Shipyard Limited Non-Executive positions is 33 years for UR/EWS candidates. The Assistant Superintendent (Hindi Translator) vacancy is reserved for OBC-NCL candidates with a notified upper age limit of 36 years, while the maximum age for Steward cum Cook is 41 years for UR/EWS candidates. Age is calculated as on 30 September 2026. || OBC-NCL candidates are eligible for 3 years of age relaxation and SC/ST candidates for 5 years over the applicable UR/EWS age limit, subject to reservation rules. Relaxation for Ex-Servicemen, Ex-Agniveers, PwBD and eligible internal candidates is governed by the applicable rules. The advertisement also contains an overall maximum-age provision of 56 years after relaxation.
application_fee: Candidates should verify their eligibility before payment because the application fee will not be refunded. Applications requiring a fee may be rejected if the prescribed payment is not completed.
selection_process: The written examination will normally contain 25% General Aptitude questions and 75% questions related to the relevant subject or trade. The selection weightage differs according to the post category.

title: Chief General Manager, General Manager, Additional General Manager, Deputy General Manager, Manager, Deputy Manager and Junior Manager in various disciplines (24 posts)
qualification: Lateral Entry to the 3rd Semester of an 8 Semester course/ 2nd year of a 4 years course will also be considered an equivalent qualification. || Post graduate integrated Degree Courses will also be allowed for Engineering disciplines in Technical posts. salary: Candidates employed in Government or a PSU must have part of their total experience in the immediate lower pay scale, as shown below. || For candidates in a CDA pay scale, the immediate lower pay scale under GSL policy will be followed, and they must have 2 years of service in it. || For posts at E-7 and above (Regular and Fixed Term), candidates from Private Sector organizations must have their last two years of experience in a company with an annual turnover of at least Rs 100 crores, and must have discharged duties in a similar role. || The annual turnover criterion does not apply to posts below the E-7 level (Regular and Fixed Term), but the candidate should still have discharged duties in a similar role. || Candidates working in PSUs on a fixed term tenure with consolidated pay will be considered in line with Private Sector Organizations.

After all age relaxations, the candidate should still have 03 years of residual service as on the cut-off date.
application_fee: Applications without the prescribed fee are liable to be rejected. The candidature of applicants who pay less than the prescribed fee, or pay by any other method, will be rejected.
